```{r setup, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## loading packages
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

## setting working directory:
setwd("../r-scripts/")

## the path to the multiqc json file
json_file_path <- "../results/multiqc/20250915_qc_run_multiqc_report_data/multiqc_data.json"

```

```{r import_data, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}

## import the json multiqc data file
multiqc_data <- fromJSON(json_file_path)

## import the metadata file
metadata <- read.delim("../results/metadata/teicon_mgs_metadata.tsv",
                       head=TRUE,
                       sep="\t")

## creating a table from the Metadata
datatable(metadata,
          caption = "Table 1. Metadata file of 100 samples for the TEICON project. This is an interactive table",
            options = list(pageLength = 10, 
                           scrollX = TRUE,
                           dom = 'Bfrtip',
                           buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print')),
            rownames = FALSE)

```


```{r create_tables, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
# Extract and tidy the data

#Extract the fastqc from the raw data from JSON
fastqc_raw_data_list <- multiqc_data$report_general_stats_data$fastqc

#Extract the fastp from the filtered data from JSON
fastp_data_list <- multiqc_data$report_general_stats_data$fastp

#Extract the fastp from the filtered data from JSON
fastqc_filt_data_list <- multiqc_data$report_general_stats_data$`fastqc-1`

#Extract the bowtie2 host filtering data from the filtered data from JSON
bowtie2_host_data_list <- multiqc_data$report_general_stats_data$`bowtie2-1`

#Extract the bowtie2 Phix filtering data from the filtered data from JSON
bowtie2_phix_data_list <- multiqc_data$report_general_stats_data$bowtie2



```


```{r process_list_files, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
# Process the FastQC data:
# - Create a dataframe from the list
# - Create a clean 'sample' name by removing the '_raw_1' or '_raw_2' suffix
# - Group by the clean sample name and sum the reads from the paired-end files
fastqc_raw_df <- map_dfr(fastqc_raw_data_list, ~tibble(
    total_sequences = .x$total_sequences
  ), .id = "filename") %>%
  mutate(sample = str_remove(filename, "_raw_[12]$")) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(reads_before_qc = sum(total_sequences/2, na.rm = TRUE))


# Process the fastp data. The sample names are already clean.
fastp_df <- map_dfr(fastp_data_list, ~tibble(
    # The number of reads that passed all filters
    reads_after_fastp = (.x$filtering_result_passed_filter_reads/2)
  ), .id = "sample")


# Process the fastqc_filt data. The sample names are already clean.
fastqc_filt_df <- map_dfr(fastqc_filt_data_list, ~tibble(
    total_sequences = .x$total_sequences
  ), .id = "filename") %>%
  mutate(sample = str_remove(filename, "_trimmed_[12]$")) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(final_reads = sum(total_sequences/2, na.rm = TRUE))

# Process the bowtie2 host data. The sample names are already clean.
bowtie2_host_df <- map_dfr(bowtie2_host_data_list, ~tibble(
    total_sequences = (.x$paired_aligned_none )
  ), .id = "filename") %>%
  mutate(sample = filename) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(reads_after_host = sum(total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE))

# Process the bowtie2 host data. The sample names are already clean.
bowtie2_phix_df <- map_dfr(bowtie2_phix_data_list, ~tibble(
    total_sequences = .x$paired_aligned_none
  ), .id = "filename") %>%
  mutate(sample = filename) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(reads_after_phix = sum(total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE))

# Join the different data frames by the sample id, first create a list of dataframes
df_list <- list(fastqc_raw_df, fastp_df, bowtie2_host_df, bowtie2_phix_df, fastqc_filt_df)

# use the reduce function to sequenctially join the dataframes from the df_list
final_read_counts_df <- reduce(df_list, left_join, by ="sample") %>%
  mutate(sample = str_remove(sample, "_run0")) 

## add colums, to indicate reads removed
final_read_counts_df$fastp_removed <- final_read_counts_df$reads_before_qc - final_read_counts_df$reads_after_fastp
final_read_counts_df$host_removed <- final_read_counts_df$reads_after_fastp - final_read_counts_df$reads_after_host
final_read_counts_df$phix_removed <- final_read_counts_df$reads_after_host - final_read_counts_df$reads_after_phix
final_read_counts_df$perc_removed <- ((final_read_counts_df$reads_before_qc- final_read_counts_df$final_reads)/final_read_counts_df$reads_before_qc)*100

# creating a table from the readcounts
## creating a table from the Metadata
datatable(final_read_counts_df,
          caption = "Table 2. Read counts for the different QC steps from the MAG pipeline with the  100 samples for the TEICON project. This is an interactive table",
            options = list(pageLength = 10, 
                           scrollX = TRUE,
                           dom = 'Bfrtip',
                           buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print')),
            rownames = FALSE)


```

```{r summary_stats, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE, warning= FALSE}
## making a table with the averages as input, and as final reads
summary_stats <- final_read_counts_df %>%
  summarise(across(c(reads_before_qc, reads_after_fastp, reads_after_host, reads_after_phix, final_reads, perc_removed),
                   list(average = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
                        median = ~median(., na.rm =TRUE),
                        st.dev = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE))))%>%
pivot_longer(everything(), 
                      names_to = c("variable", ".value"), 
                      names_pattern = "(.*)_(average|median|st.dev)") %>%
  mutate(across(c(average,median, st.dev), ~round(., 1)))

knitr::kable(summary_stats, "simple", align = "lcc")

```


Using the above two tables we can show figures with the differences per QC step for the 100 teicon samples.

```{r Boxplot_samples, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}

##Normal numbers
options(scipen=999)


# first I merge the two table metadata and the final_read_counts_df. and I make it a long table

teicon_qc <- left_join(final_read_counts_df, metadata, by ="sample") %>%
  select(sample,
         reads_before_qc,
         reads_after_fastp,
         reads_after_host,
         reads_after_phix,
         final_reads,
         Host,
         Sampletype) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(reads_before_qc, reads_after_fastp, reads_after_host, reads_after_phix, final_reads),
            names_to="variable",
            values_to="value" )

## variable needs to be orders
teicon_qc$variable <- factor(teicon_qc$variable,
                                levels=c("reads_before_qc",
                                         "reads_after_fastp",
                                         "reads_after_host",
                                         "reads_after_phix",
                                         "final_reads"))


## plot boxplot with ggplot for Hubbard
p <- teicon_qc %>%
  filter(Host == "Hubbard") %>%
  ggplot( aes(x=variable, y=(value/1000000))) + 
  geom_violin()+
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.5, size=2.2, aes(color=Host))+
  xlab("Quality control step")+
  ylab("Million PE-reads (n)")+
  labs(fill = "Quality control step")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) 
# sets the x-axis labels in a way to be readable

p

## plot boxplot with ggplot for Ross
p <- teicon_qc %>%
  filter(Host == "Ross 308") %>%
  ggplot( aes(x=variable, y=(value/1000000))) + 
  geom_violin()+
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.5, size=2.2, aes(color=Host))+
  xlab("Quality control step")+
  ylab("Million PE-reads (n)")+
  labs(fill = "Quality control step")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) 
# sets the x-axis labels in a way to be readable

p


## plot boxplot with ggplot for Kalkun
p <- teicon_qc %>%
  filter(Host == "Kalkun") %>%
  ggplot( aes(x=variable, y=(value/1000000))) + 
  geom_violin()+
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.5, size=2.2, aes(color=Host))+

  ylab("Million PE-reads (n)")+

  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) 
# sets the x-axis labels in a way to be readable

p

## plot boxplot with ggplot for controls

  filter(Host == "N/A") %>%
  ggplot( aes(x=variable, y=(value))) + 
  geom_violin()+
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.5, size=2.2, aes(color=Host))+
  xlab("Quality control step")+
  ylab("PE-reads (n)")+

p


```



```{r Plot_removed, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
#create_the table
teicon_qc <- left_join(final_read_counts_df, metadata, by ="sample") %>%
  select(sample,
         reads_before_qc,
         reads_after_fastp,
         reads_after_host,
         reads_after_phix,
         final_reads,
         fastp_removed,
         host_removed,
         phix_removed,
         Host,
         Sampletype)

ggplot(teicon_qc, aes(x=reads_before_qc, y=final_reads, colour = Host)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.5, size=2.2)+
  stat_ellipse(aes(group=Host), type="norm", level=0.95, linetype="solid", linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5)+
  xlab("input reads")+
  ylab("clean reads")+
  labs(colour = "Host")+
  geom_hline(yintercept=(mean(teicon_qc$value)),
             color="black", 
             linetype='dashed')


```

``` {r plot_host_removed_reads_2, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}

## calculate percentage removed of all reads
teicon_qc$perc_removed <- ((teicon_qc$reads_before_qc-teicon_qc$final_reads)/teicon_qc$reads_before_qc)*100


ggplot(teicon_qc, aes(x=reads_before_qc, y=perc_removed, colour = Host)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.5, size=2.2)+
  stat_ellipse(aes(group=Host), type="norm", level=0.95, linetype="solid", size=0.5, alpha=0.5)+
  xlab("input reads")+
  ylab("Percentage reads removed")+
  ylim(0,20)+
  labs(colour = "Host")+
  ggtitle("MAG QC percentage of removed reads.")



```
``` {r plot_host_removed_reads, echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE }

## calculate percentage removed of all reads
teicon_qc$perc_removed <- ((teicon_qc$reads_before_qc-teicon_qc$final_reads)/teicon_qc$reads_before_qc)*100




p <- teicon_qc %>%
  filter(Host != "N/A") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=(reads_before_qc/1000000), y=perc_removed, colour = Host)) +

  #ylim(0,)+

p
```
